chunks: 4730 - And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, he said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"O Fāṭimah, pierce the ears of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn in مخالفة to the Jews."

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator to whom this report is attributed
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ: al-Ḥasan, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Ḥusayn, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.اُثْقُبِي: pierce; an imperative command addressed to a female

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about piercing the ears of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an instruction from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله to Fāṭimah concerning piercing the ears of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn. It presents the act as a deliberate distinction from Jewish practice and appears within the context of rulings and customs related to newborn children.
